title: Divergence: thermite-lower lower_expr/lower_inv_expr Call arms cast a bool-typed Binary/Unary spec-call arg 'as u64' (spec_call_param_cast bool=>None collapses into the unwrap_or(u64) fallback) — E0308, L0 death on correct source

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at thermite-lower/tests/divergence_spec_call_bool_arg_cast.rs::{spec_call_bool_binary_arg_takes_no_cast,spec_call_bool_unary_arg_takes_no_cast} demonstrates divergence. req s_b(x, x < y) emits s_b(x, (x < y) as u64); req s_b(1, !flag) emits s_b(1, (!flag) as u64) — verus E0308 expected bool found u64, live-confirmed. Surface unary set is exactly Not (REQ-10 #92), so EVERY Expr::Unary arg is bool-typed; the #225 'bool arm is defensive' premise is false. All spec_call_param_cast consumer sites affected (lower_expr Call arm + lower_inv_expr Call arm).
